What We Offer

Getting into medical school isn't easy.

In fact, around 70% of applicants never make it. With help from someone who gets people in each year, the application is much more successful and less daunting.

All in one place

It contains all of the content you need to get into Medical School, and it's all on this page. No need to sift through countless pages of dated information, when you can find it all here.

85% offer rate

Historically, 85–90% of my students get offers and into Medical School each year.

In depth approach

The course goes into the necessary depth to teach you each step of the application, so that you stand out.

About the Course

Why this course exists.

This is a course I have designed for applying medical and dental students to help them get offers and places at medical and dental school. The key philosophy behind this course is to teach you everything there is to know, with no hidden costs. So many sites out there only offer support in certain areas, and they expect prior knowledge on ethics and reflection in medicine, without teaching it. This course has been designed to take you from the start of the application and actually teach you about medical ethics, reflections and how to find work experience, on top of the commonly taught UCAT and MMIs. Ultimately, I made this because no one else is teaching these things, and I remember never having anyone tell me holistically about applying to medical school.

Your Instructor

Hi, I'm Bryn.

I am a 4th year medical student, studying in the UK. I take pride in helping people each year with their applications, and find it incredibly rewarding. I began to increase my reach of people I help through posting YouTube videos on my 2 channels — Bryn Irons and Med With Bryn. Additionally, I make some shorter videos on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.

I am fascinated in medicine. Choosing to study medicine is the best choice I have ever made. I have a deep fascination for the human body and would love to become a plastic surgeon.

In my spare time, I like editing videos, playing Badminton, playing chess, and travelling.
